model.input_products: OSTIA SST, SMAP/SMOS SSS, DUACS SLA, OSCAR currents, CCMP winds
model.temperature_is: RAW model output, stored as float16. Subtract correction.depth_bias per depth for the Argo-corrected profile; compute MLD from the raw profile.
